paragraphs: R. Yaakov Gevula'ah and R. Levi, in R. Ḥanina's name, Midrash Kohelet, at the verse 'A generation goes and a generation comes.' Gevulya, in R. Ḥanina's name, Ḥallah, chapter 3, halakhah 2. R. Immi said: Yaakov Gevulya recited before R. Yoḥanan. R. Yitzḥak bar Tavlayya, in R. Shimon ben Lakish's name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter HeArel, halakhah 2, and chapter Asarah Yuḥasin, halakhah 3.
